text:
maria-sales: FYI — Prospect TitanLedger is evaluating moving their transaction-analysis pipeline from CloudPrompt. They want a 3-week POC, a security questionnaire filled, and a committed pricing sketch for 12 months. Can presales triage?
josh-presales: I can run the kickoff. Need eng + security for feasibility and any legal redlines. High-level asks: sessioned chat, search reranker, and embeddings for vector match.
hiro-eng: Pinged. Two immediate constraints: 1) they stream very large contexts (12k-16k) and pin model versions; 2) they rely on deterministic reranker scoring across requests.
nina-security: I'll take the SQ. Any regulatory constraints? PCI/PCI-DSS or regional data residency?
maria-sales: TitanLedger is US + EU, handles obfuscated card references and needs SOC2 + custom KMS policies.
sofia-solutions: For POC architecture I propose: Dedicated pool (US-EAST), prefix KV caching, and a rerank microservice that calls Redwood embeddings+rerank. If they need EU data locality we can add Private later.
hiro-eng: Agreed. Note: CloudPrompt sends session-state separate from messages (session_token header). We'll provide a shim that maps session_token -> Redwood session and persist KV pointers. Also need to map stop sequences and temperature semantics.
sofia-solutions: Example Node proxy snippet (what they'd run during POC):
```js
// proxy: cloudprompt -> redwood
fetch('/v1/redwood/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer REDWOOD_KEY', 'X-Session': req.headers['session_token'] },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-chat-16k', input: req.body.messages, kv_cache: true })
});
```
hiro-eng: We'll supply a small token-diff harness (Python) to compare CloudPrompt token counts vs Redwood for the same prompts. Acceptance: <= 5% token delta across sample set.
josh-presales: Pricing ask: they estimated current monthly spend ~ $80k on CloudPrompt (chat + embeddings) and want to know Redwood delta for 50M input tokens + 10M embedding units. Can someone do a staged estimate (hosted vs dedicated)?
sofia-solutions: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted forecast ~ $0.08/token (example) -> unrealistic; need model-specific numbers. For Dedicated, propose commit of 2x A100-equivalents: monthly commit ~$45k + per-token usage ~ $0.01 for excess; embeddings priced separately. I'll flesh out exacts for the one-pager.
nina-security: SQ questions I'll answer: KMS support (AWS KMS, customer-managed keys), HSM option for Private, audit logs (retention and redaction), access controls (SCIM + RBAC), and breach notification SLA. Also need to document what metadata we persist for reranker (IDs only).
hiro-eng: Reranker parity: CloudPrompt returns a score array and stable ordering. Our reranker uses cosine over embeddings; to reduce delta we should: 1) fix embedding model/version 2) normalize vectors 3) run reranker on the same candidate set. We'll include a reproducibility test where we compute embeddings in-batch and compare rank correlation (Spearman rho >= 0.95 target).
infra-bot: infra: dedicated staging pool request submitted -> job d-poc-7712 pending approval.
cicd-bot: deploy pipeline created: teams/sales/poc/titanledger.
sofia-solutions: POC acceptance checklist I'll draft: ["tokenization delta <= 5%","rerank spearman >= 0.95","95th pctl latency <= current SLA","no unencrypted persisted PII","fallback plan documented (Dedicated -> Hosted)"]
josh-presales: Procurement wants fallback behavior documented (if Dedicated saturates, burst to Hosted is allowed with contractized privacy guarantees). Can security provide wording?
nina-security: We'll add a fallback clause: Hosted fallback allowed only for transient bursts, data-in-transit encrypted, no persistent storage on Hosted, explicit opt-in in contract, and audit trail visible to customer.
maria-sales: Good. Also question from TitanLedger: will sampling/seed differences cause different deterministic outputs compared to CloudPrompt? They rely on deterministic scoring in a small subset of flows.
hiro-eng: Short: generation sampling can differ — for deterministic output we recommend temperature=0 and a deterministic decoding algorithm (greedy / beam with fixed seed) where supported. For reranker/scoring we keep deterministic embedding + cosine, so it's stable. We'll provide runnable seeds and compare outputs.
sofia-solutions: Timeline for POC: Day 0: NDA + SQ exchange. Day 1-2: network allowlist + staging access. Day 3-8: shim + tokenization and rerank parity tests. Day 9-14: load + latency tests on Dedicated. Day 15-18: security review + billing proposal. Day 19-21: final signoff.
josh-presales: Owner list: @hiro-eng tech lead, @nina-security sec lead, @sofia-solutions pricing & shim, @maria-sales customer lead.
hina-security: (typo) I'll get started with SQ answers now.
sofia-solutions: I'll prepare a simple cost comparison table for the one-pager (hosted vs dedicated commit vs private). Also will include a code snippet for the rerank shim and a small prompt-rewrite guide to reduce token footprint.
maria-sales: I'll schedule the customer kickoff for next Tue. Thanks team. :rocket:
